cases.name: empty_construction
cases.action: Run source Stage0 for each supported private Session kind
cases.expect: Distinct map created before pending publication, map size0, no bindings before Stage1

cases.name: registration_prefix
cases.action: At first Stage1 index2 bind only SetInt, execute SetInt('prefix',41), inspect GetInt before index3
cases.expect: GetInt remains nil until its own exact index3 delivery; index3 GetInt returns41

cases.name: registration_failure_prefix
cases.action: Reject provider before index2 or index3
cases.expect: Original delivered prefix remains; no preinstalled later callback; map/receiver survive until session cleanup

cases.name: stage1_repeat
cases.action: Complete load, insert value, rerun actual Stage1 and Stage2
cases.expect: Same map and receiver, prior value preserved, source library stack grows5, registrations repeat in source order

cases.name: pending_active
cases.action: SetInt during source common/external load then publish active=pending
cases.expect: Same original Session map across load and publication; current active selection is independent of owning context

cases.name: private_sessions
cases.action: Run two actual owners, store same key differently
cases.expect: Distinct VM/map/receiver; GetInt misses insert0 only in selected Session

cases.name: same_owner_replacement
cases.action: Invoke captured lifecycle replacement with old active/pending and new selected source session
cases.expect: New map empty, old session finalizers execute with old receiver, no inherited integer values

cases.name: nested_include
cases.action: Root file SetInt, Include file GetInt/SetInt through genuine same-VM source scope
cases.expect: Same owned map, original cache and loaded-file order, unchanged generic busy protections

cases.name: source_false_load
cases.action: Use authentic root missing/protected-error result after prior SetInt prefix
cases.expect: Map prefix remains; source loaded-set false and continued publication unchanged

cases.name: missing_fraction
cases.action: Ordinary key succeeds; fractional numeric key with missing provider is protected error
cases.expect: No synthetic libc success, no extra map insertion, ordinary calls remain genuine

cases.name: missing_identity
cases.action: Source-projected table has genuine nonzero native identity and no source32 mapper
cases.expect: Protected explicit unsupported coercion before map mutation; null identity still uses0x00000000

cases.name: close_finalizers
cases.action: Install newproxy finalizer, add aliases/integers, destroy actual owner/session
cases.expect: Aliases empty and GetInt missing inserts0 at finalizer entry; SetInt reinsertion works; external observer records effects; wrappers freed only afterclose

cases.name: malformed_config
cases.expect: Explicit native malformed rejection before Session construction/publication, no fabricated original input branch

cases.name: linked_provenance
cases.action: Replay via actual central owner/runtime DSOs under ASan/UBSan/leak checking
cases.expect: New source/binary/report hashes, zero findings, historical nil-binding test/report untouched
